'''Ayceezee''' was an inhabited world in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with rolling walkways and a [[Ayceezee Public College|university]] as of [[44 ABY]]. Former [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Voort saBinring]] retired there as a mathematics [[Professor/Legends|professor]] until re-recruited by [[Garik Loran]] in 44 ABY.
